title: Just Juice Bar Range Lychee & Mango 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: The Just Juice Bar Range Lychee & Mango Nic Salt e-liquid brings together the lush tropical sweetness of exotic Lychee and the juicy, sun-kissed taste of ripe Mango. Designed to deliver an extra-intense flavour experience, this e-liquid mimics the punchy flavours of disposable vapes, making it ideal for vapers who love fabulously-fruity blends with maximum taste. Crafted with a 60PG/40VG ratio, the Just Juice Bar Range is ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod systems. Its smooth Nicotine Salt formulation provides a comfortable yet satisfyingly tactile throat hit and rapid nicotine delivery, offering an effective and convenient alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Lychee & Mango is perfect for vapers who seek vibrant, tropical flavours they can enjoy all day long. Part of the Just Juice Bar Range, this collection captures the bold, intense flavours vapers enjoyed by fans of disposable vapes, but in a more versatile and economical format designed for refillable vapes . Other popular flavours include Blackcurrant Lemonade, Spearmint, and Sour Blue Razz Lime. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
